design.owner: one private Checker and its TypeStore/binder; query-local, no stored cache
design.identity: root symbol plus supplying concrete reference, original receiver, read identity and declaration metadata
design.publication: completed read view; active resolved-base prefix refused for completion; failure and unsupported distinct
design.reset: no persistent member view; each request forces current bases and rebuilds the view; no reset-to-completed shortcut
design.consumer: intersection property_type_via_shape only; other callers keep existing behavior
design.work: base forcing, supplier walk and member instantiation; no execution-count or saved-time claim
design.limits: prototype only: declaration-owned property/accessor intersections, no union/index/mapped/static/mixin/augmentation/signature/cross-worker qualification; clone view is not a minted native symbol

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import time

root = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-member-consumer-path').read_text().strip())
label = sys.argv[1]
assert not (root / (label + '.json')).exists(), label
command = sys.argv[2:]
source = root / 'source'
def hashes():
    return {str(p.relative_to(source)): hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
            for p in sorted(source.rglob('*.rs'))}
before = hashes()
env = os.environ.copy()
env['CARGO_TARGET_DIR'] = str(root / 'target')
env['CARGO_BUILD_JOBS'] = '2'
start = time.time()
with (root / (label + '.stdout')).open('w') as out, (root / (label + '.stderr')).open('w') as err:
    process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=source, env=env, stdout=out, stderr=err)
    print(json.dumps({'label': label, 'pid': process.pid, 'command': command}), flush=True)
    code = process.wait()
after = hashes()
record = {'label': label, 'pid': process.pid, 'command': command,
          'source_revision': json.loads((root / 'setup.json').read_text())['source_revision'],
          'returncode': code, 'seconds': time.time() - start,
          'source_hashes_before': before, 'source_hashes_after': after,
          'source_unchanged_during_run': before == after,
          'stdout': (root / (label + '.stdout')).read_text(),
          'stderr': (root / (label + '.stderr')).read_text()}
(root / (label + '.json')).write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2))
assert before == after, 'source mutated while work live'
print(json.dumps({k: record[k] for k in ('label','pid','returncode','seconds','source_unchanged_during_run')}))
print(record['stdout'][-7000:])
print(record['stderr'][-1500:])

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import json

root = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-member-consumer-path').read_text().strip())
p = root / 'source/crates/tsr-checker/src/members.rs'
original = p.read_text()
mutations = [
    ('unconditional-synthesis',
     'if first.root == second.root\n                && first.read == second.read',
     'if false\n                && first.read == second.read',
     'member_consumer_common_self'),
    ('bare-symbol-merge',
     'if first.root == second.root\n                && first.read == second.read',
     'if first.root == second.root\n                && true',
     'member_consumer_generic_reads'),
    ('receiving-owner-mapper',
     'self.instantiate_for_reference_with_this(id, declared, receiver)',
     'self.instantiate_for_reference_with_this(receiver, declared, receiver)',
     'member_consumer_common_self'),
    ('partial-as-complete',
     'if self.resolutions.on_stack(owner, crate::resolution::PropertyName::ResolvedBaseTypes)\n            || path.contains(&owner)',
     'if false',
     'member_consumer_active_bases'),
]
records = []
for label, old, new, test in mutations:
    assert old in original, label
    p.write_text(original.replace(old, new, 1))
    (root / ('mutant-' + label + '.rs')).write_text(p.read_text())
    subprocess.run(['python3','/tmp/tsr-member-consumer-run.py', 'mutant-' + label,
                    'cargo','test','--release','--offline','-p','tsr-checker','--lib',test,
                    '--','--nocapture'], check=True)
    result = json.loads((root / ('mutant-' + label + '.json')).read_text())
    assert result['returncode'] == 101 and 'test result: FAILED.' in result['stdout'], label
    records.append({'label': label, 'caught': True, 'test': test, 'pid': result['pid']})
    p.write_text(original)
(root / 'mutations.json').write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2))

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import time

root = Path(Path('/tmp/tsr-member-consumer-path').read_text().strip())
repo = Path('/Users/mohebifar/dev/tsr')
native = Path('/private/tmp/tsr-native-symbol-completion-5b/clean')
assert hashlib.sha256(native.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '6340b230f887095fb7c82fedb41eecadd7dc49e4baa65a05ef4abb8ab4b74bc4'
fixtures = []
for filename in ['checker-native-shared-property.json', 'checker-native-recursive-bases.json']:
    receipt = json.loads((repo / 'docs/architecture' / filename).read_text())
    for row in receipt['public']['rows']:
        if row['mode'] == 'default':
            fixtures.append({'producer':filename, 'case':row['case'], 'variant':row.get('variant','base'),
                             'content':row['content'], 'config':row['config']})
rows = []
def normalized(output):
    # Keep every diagnostic line and body. Only file spellings, library list
    # lines, blank lines and formatter summary counts are projected separately.
    diagnostics = []
    files = []
    for line in output.splitlines():
        if 'error TS' in line:
            line = re.sub(r'^.*?input\.ts(?=\()', 'input.ts', line)
        elif line.startswith('bundled:///') or line.endswith('.ts'):
            files.append(line)
            continue
        if re.match(r'^Found \d+ errors?', line) or not line.strip():
            continue
        diagnostics.append(line)
    return '\n'.join(diagnostics), files

for fixture in fixtures:
    directory = root / 'public' / (fixture['case'] + '-' + fixture['variant'])
    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (directory / 'input.ts').write_text(fixture['content'])
    (directory / 'tsconfig.json').write_text(json.dumps(fixture['config'], indent=2))
    for tool, binary in [('native', native), ('baseline',root/'baseline-tsr'),('prototype',root/'prototype-tsr')]:
        for mode in ['default','single']:
            command = [str(binary), '--project',str(directory/'tsconfig.json'),'--pretty','false',
                       '--noEmit','--incremental','false','--composite','false','--listFiles']
            if mode == 'single': command += ['--singleThreaded','true']
            start = time.time()
            process = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=directory, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
            stdout, stderr = process.communicate(timeout=60)
            diag, files = normalized(stdout)
            row = {**fixture,'tool':tool,'mode':mode,'command':command,'pid':process.pid,
                   'returncode':process.returncode,'seconds':time.time()-start,
                   'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                   'input_sha256':hashlib.sha256((directory/'input.ts').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                   'config_sha256':hashlib.sha256((directory/'tsconfig.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
                   'stdout':stdout,'stderr':stderr,'normalized_diagnostics':diag,'listed_files':files}
            rows.append(row)
            (root/'public-progress.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2))
            print(json.dumps({k:row[k] for k in ['case','variant','tool','mode','pid','returncode']}),flush=True)
assert len({x['pid'] for x in rows}) == len(rows)
mode_equal = True
for fixture in fixtures:
    for tool in ['native','baseline','prototype']:
        pair = [x for x in rows if x['case']==fixture['case'] and x['variant']==fixture['variant'] and x['tool']==tool]
        mode_equal &= len(pair)==2 and all(pair[0][k]==pair[1][k] for k in ['returncode','stdout','stderr','listed_files'])
result = {'rows':rows,'count':len(rows),'mode_output_equal':mode_equal,
          'no_speed_claim':True,'full_corpora_run':False,
          'normalization':'file spellings and formatter summaries only; all diagnostic text retained, loaded files recorded separately'}
(root/'public.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2))
assert mode_equal
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k!='rows'}))
